server.note: en server, servern, servrar. Add Server = 'Lägg till server', Remove Server = 'Ta bort server'.

tab.note: en flik, fliken, flikar. New Tab = 'Ny flik', Close Tab = 'Stäng flik'.

view.note: en vy, vyer. Existing renders 'view limit' as 'visningsgräns' ('Visningsgränsen nådd') — keep that phrase for the limit message.

popout window.note: Existing translates 'Popout Menu' as 'Popup-meny', which conflates popup and popout. Prefer 'popout-fönster'; 'eget fönster' works in running text ('öppna i eget fönster').

notification area.note: Official Windows Swedish term is 'meddelandefältet'; existing desktop strings render both 'notification area' and 'system tray' as 'systemfältet'. Use 'meddelandefält' only when mirroring Windows settings wording, otherwise follow 'systemfältet'.

taskbar.note: Official Windows Swedish term: 'aktivitetsfältet'. Existing has a typo 'aktivitetesfält' once — use 'aktivitetsfält'.

badge.note: Inconsistent today: heading 'Oläst märke' but body text 'en röd markering'. Use 'märke' for the badge itself; 'markering' acceptable in descriptive text.

downloads.note: Menu item: 'Nedladdningar'. Download Location = 'plats för nedladdningar'; running text sometimes uses 'hämtade filer'.

authentication secret.note: Existing: 'Den här servern kräver en autentiseringshemlighet.'

hardware acceleration.note: Existing rendering; Microsoft style would be 'maskinvaruacceleration' but keep 'hårdvaruacceleration' for consistency.

title bar.note: Existing: 'det inbyggda titelfältet' (native title bar). Windows official term is 'namnlist', but keep 'titelfält' for consistency.

zoom.note: Verb: 'zooma'; Zoom In = 'Zooma in', Zoom Out = 'Zooma ut', Actual Size = 'Verklig storlek'.

clear data.note: Clear All Data = 'Rensa all data'; Clear Cache and Reload = 'Rensa cache och ladda om'.

logging level.note: Existing writes 'Logg-nivå'; prefer the solid compound 'loggnivå'. Show logs = 'Visa loggar'.
